text:
Hey Puneet, Kemal and Anthony,

It was a pleasure meeting you all today so thanks for taking the time to
speak.

Building effective VLA's for Five AI's next deployment will require large
volumes of high quality, annotated data. The group is already en-route to
starting this project and would like to partner with Encord to avoid the
time, cost and complexity associated with building out a data curation and
labelling tool internally. The real goal is to get deployment ready models
to market as soon as possible.

Key takeaways from the call (please add anything we've missed):

   - *Scale: *The VLA annotation project will require a system that can
   handle millions of frames. Encord has been proven to work with 100m+ files.
   - *Curation:* More doesn't = better. The Five AI team needs an efficient
   process for slicing data and focusing on the images/videos that will have
   the highest impact on model performance. Encords Index/Active modules have
   been built to solve this problem. Embeddings (ours or your own) will enable
   you to identify edge cases and focus on specific scenes that should be
   prioritised for annotation.
   - *VLA workflows:* Five AI need a tool that can handle VLA annotation
   tasks in complex scenarios (e.g., dangerous objects, pedestrian intent). We
   used robotics as an example but are working with world leaders in the ADAS
   space (e.g. Woven) and can support all workflow requirements outlined in
   the call.
   - *Automated labelling:* Working with massive datasets can require
   automated labelling to reduce the human load. Encord enables clients to
   sync data pipelines with your models and pre-label where appropriate.
